entries.message: An address you type or paste in the command palette now opens at the #section you gave it, even on a page you've visited before, and changing only the #section of the page you're on moves within that page.

Return in the command palette now searches anything that isn't an address, such as crest browser or a single word, with matching tabs, sites and history still listed below. An address such as github.com or localhost:3000 still opens, and the field completes one as you type it.
History results in the command palette now show their site's icon with a small clock badge, so results from different sites are easy to tell apart.
